title: Loyalty Pass v1.6.18 Update
notes: Interactive account-not-found registration prompt, Google sign-in/sign-up integration, and login button fixes.
features: Account not found prompt: displays interactive 1-tap Create New Account banner when unregistered mobile enters login
Auto pre-fill mobile number into registration when redirecting from failed login
Google Account authentication: Continue with Google & Sign up with Google on both login and register screens
Fixed dead button event handlers by resolving class structure syntax
Strict 10-digit mobile number constraints across all login, register, and Google auth inputs
